text: {"lessons":["A long stretch of losses can materially erode account value, so I should periodically review risk and whether my holdings still fit my goals.","Staying invested avoids impulsive trading, but doing nothing without checking my portfolio can leave risks or imbalances unaddressed.","I should use regular, deliberate reviews and clear criteria for rebalancing rather than relying on short-term price moves or checking only a few times a year."]}
